name: DISPLAY_FILES_SQL outlook graphics 202610152347
sql: SELECT 'display' AS source, v.product, v.advisory_or_cycle, v.vintage_key, v.revision, v.revision > 0 AS corrected, v.r2_key, v.sha256, v.byte_size, v.issued_ts, v.published_ts, v.meta, o.r2_key AS original_r2_key, o.sha256 AS original_sha256, o.byte_size AS original_bytes FROM tropical_display_in_force AS v LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.r2_key, a.sha256, a.byte_size FROM tropical_file_vintage AS a WHERE v.revision > 0 AND a.source = 'display' AND a.product = v.product AND a.storm_id = v.storm_id AND a.vintage_key = v.advisory_or_cycle AND a.status = 'banked') AS o ON true WHERE v.product = ANY ('{display:two_areas,display:two_points}'::text[]) AND v.storm_id = '' AND v.advisory_or_cycle = '202610152347' ORDER BY v.product
